title: Asked to post something in another channel, Olisar posts it and reacts instead of replying

beats.speaker: rook
beats.text: olisar can you drop "maintenance window is 02:00-04:00 UTC saturday" in #arena-announcements for me

notes: The shape the feature exists for. Olisar has done the thing; 'done' adds nothing, so the reaction is the reply. The target channel is checked by eye — the run only asserts that something visible happened here and that it wasn't words. Two failures to watch for: a reaction AND a 'posted it!', which is the tool being treated as a garnish rather than the reply; and a reaction with nothing posted in #arena-announcements, which is silence hiding a failed action.
